youtube.title: What the Hole in Your Pan Handle Is Really For 🍳 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The hole at the end of most pan handles is there so the pan can hang on a hook or rail, which saves cupboard space and lets the pan air-dry after washing. The viral claim that it was designed to hold your stirring spoon is a fun hack that does work with some spoons, but manufacturers add the hole for hanging storage.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.

#Shorts #science #facts #thehiddenwhy

sources: Cookware makers' product notes: handle hole for hanging storage
Fact checks: spoon-rest use is a hack, not the design purpose
